items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 4:1
items.html: Since AA clothes Atik only from the Peh of his head and downward, therefore the Rosh of Atik is discerned as hidden from AA, who does not attain it, and is therefore called Reisha deLo Iyada [the unknowable head]. As the Rav wrote, page 1302, Item 11. And although this is so in all the Partzufim, that the lower one does not clothe the Rosh of the upper one but only his body, nevertheless no Rosh is called by the name RDL"A except the Rosh of Atik alone. However, the intention is that AA has no aspect of the vessel of reception of the RDL"A at all, for the vessels of reception of the RDL"A are from the Malchut of restriction 1, as above in answer 124. And the aspect of the vessels of reception of AA is from the Malchut of restriction 2, and therefore the RDL"A is entirely hidden from AA, having no resemblance to it. This is unlike the rest of the Partzufim, where although the lower one does not clothe the Rosh of the upper one, nevertheless the Malchut of the Rosh of the upper one expands within it, with its vessels of reception, by which it clothes the lights that expand from the Rosh of the upper one, since there is no change in their vessels of reception, and therefore they are not discerned as the aspect of the RDL"A with respect to their lower one. And see page 1297, Sub Header, "Sitra". (Vol. 1, p. 302, Item 11).
